name: Lucy Graves
want: see the West for herself and make her own way in it
secret: She is meant to marry a man she has never met in Oregon City, and has no intention of ever doing it.
voice: Bookish and quick, asks questions nobody else asks.
description: A New Hampshire schoolteacher travelling under the company's protection to an arranged marriage. She keeps a journal of the trail and reads it aloud at the fire.
appearance: A sunbonnet she refuses to wear, ink on her fingers.
